subject: Web Development
title: The First Website Ever
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The First Website Ever.

hook.text: On December 20, 1990, the world's first website went live. It was just text and links.

buildup.text: Hosted at info.cern.ch, it explained what the World Wide Web was and how to use it.

discovery.text: No images, no colors, no design. Just blue underlined hyperlinks on a gray page.

twist.text: The original page was lost for years. CERN restored it in 2013 as a digital artifact.

climax.text: That plain text page launched an industry now worth trillions of dollars.

punchline.text: The first website was about websites.

quiz.question: What was the first website about?
